sceneDescription: After festive ecommerce sales hit four to five times their daily average, a delivery van has apparently started using packing tape for tires. In an otherwise ordinary maintenance bay, the rear wheel of a plain white delivery van has been replaced by one absurdly oversized roll of brown packing tape. Its cardboard core surrounds the axle, and a short sticky tail adheres to the concrete floor, making the delivery vehicle look ready to wrap the road rather than drive on it. No people are present.
finalImagePrompt: An unoccupied delivery-van maintenance bay with pale walls and daylight through an open doorway. A plain white van is seen side-on, its rear wheel replaced by one enormous roll of translucent brown packing tape, its cardboard core fitted around the axle. A short peeled tape tail sticks to the worn concrete floor. The ordinary front tire remains visible. Scuffed paint, dusty rubber, genuine reflections. Wide landscape photograph; no visible writing, logos, license plates or screens.
